Grounds and impact list: bible/changelog.md BIB-0033. Written by 00-orchestration/memory-bible under on_bible_access; 05-scenes/lighting to countersign at its next open.

Decision on the 25 blind stained-glass roundels (roundel_glow below). The lamp key notes the new pastel tulip shades. Both prompt fragments gain one clause on the roundels. Enums, Kelvin and contrast are unchanged.

roundel_glow.rule: The 25 blind stained-glass roundels above the door heads have no light source behind them: no hidden oil lamp, no electric light, no daylight. They catch the hanging oil lamps from the front only. Each shows small jewel-coloured glints and a faint sheen on its lead came and glass where a lamp is close, and they fall to dull dark colour between lamps and toward the dark ends of the hall. They never glow evenly or look backlit.
roundel_glow.why: The architecture has no cavity or opening behind the roundels, and the text gives 'that dark hall' (ch001-p14). A hidden lamp behind each of 25 roundels would add 25 practical sources and brighten the hall against the source. Front-lit blind glass is plausible 1862 practical light and keeps the eleven centre-line lamps as the only key.
roundel_glow.arbitration: UPHELD 2026-09-23 against bible/color_script.json by memory-bible (BIB-0033, closing qa/defects/DEF-p6-directing-ep01-001). This decision is now the single answer for every act set in this hall, ep01 acts 3-6 and ep05 act 3 included: no daylight, no shaft, no coloured pool on the floor. Do not re-open it from the colour side.
